title: RJ Olympiad
text: Logos and title lines, header boxes with the student's details, the paper code and the exam information, an instructions page, notation and a table of values, the sections, rough-work pages, and an OMR sheet with class and registration grids.

instructions.heading: Read the following instructions carefully before attempting the question paper.

items.latex: Do not open this booklet until the invigilators say so.
Answer on the \textbf{O}ptical \textbf{M}ark \textbf{R}ecognition sheet (\textbf{OMR}) by darkening the appropriate squares (marked A, B, C, D or $0$--$9$) with a blue or black ball pen.
Write your registration number, your name and the question paper code (the letter printed at the top of this paper) in the space provided on the OMR sheet.
You won't be allowed to leave the examination hall during the exam.

block.latex:
$\bullet$ Darken your class and the digits of your registration number in the grids below.\\
$\bullet$ For a numerical answer, darken one digit in each column: if your answer is 073, darken 0 in the first column (hundreds), 7 in the second (tens) and 3 in the third (ones).

block.heading: Mark your choice for the objective questions
